_about: Manifest of scripts/build_dm72_bodies.py (app BACKLOG REF-94): UFC 3-220-20 section bodies from the printed pages. Keys: chapters (PDF pages, stop_headings, built), footnotes and table_notes (the strings the earlier bodies held, read against the print), equation_formulas (the words of each checked equations entry that are its formula), formulas (unnumbered formula lines typed in from a 300 dpi render, key printed-page@height), lines (prose lines typed in from the render), typed_tables and typed_blocks (tables the earlier bodies held typed in, kept), notes (the earlier bodies' notes on the print's slips, put back after the same words), fixes (each with its page and why).

equation_formulas.Eq. 2-2: Normalized wall stiffness Kwall = EI / (γt × h⁴)
equation_formulas.Eq. 2-8: Peak particle velocity PPV = K · SD^(−1.6)
equation_formulas.Eq. 3-4: Relative water content, printed as Δw = wopt − wfield (Equation 3-4, PDF p. 150, printed p. 112)
equation_formulas.Eq. 3-5: Dr = [(emax − e)/(emax − emin)] × 100% = [(γd,field − γd,min)/(γd,max − γd,min)] × (γd,max/γd,field) × 100%, expressed in both void ratio and dry unit weight forms
equation_formulas.Eq. 4-3: KA = (1 − sin φ') / (1 + sin φ') = tan²(45° − φ'/2)
equation_formulas.Eq. 4-4: KP = (1 + sin φ') / (1 − sin φ') = tan²(45° + φ'/2)
equation_formulas.Eq. 4-12: ln(Kp) = ln[(1 + sin φʹ)/(1 − sin φʹ)] · [1.443·(δ/φʹ)·sin φʹ + 1]
equation_formulas.Eq. 4-15: Seismic active earth pressure coefficient KAE as a function of backfill friction angle φ', backfill slope β, wall slope θ, interface friction angle δ, and seismic angle ψ = tan⁻¹(kh/(1−kv))
equation_formulas.Eq. 4-16: Total seismic active earth pressure force PAE = (γ·H²/2)·(1 − kv)·KAE
equation_formulas.Eq. 4-17: Dynamic earth pressure force component ΔPAE = (3/8) · kh · γ · H², for horizontal backfill, vertical wall face, no wall friction, and wall height < 20 ft (Seed and Whitman 1970 simplification)
equation_formulas.Eq. 4-18: ΔPE = kh · γ · H² (Wood 1973), added to static pressure to obtain total applied force
equation_formulas.Eq. 4-21: ψ = tan⁻¹[γsat · kh / ((γsat − γw)(1 − ru)(1 − kv))]
equation_formulas.Eq. 4-30: φ′allow = arctan(tan φ′ / F), providing a factor of safety on shear strength
equation_formulas.Eq. 5-1: total load (structural load + foundation weight + overlying soil weight) divided by bearing area A
equation_formulas.Eq. 5-2: gross bearing pressure minus existing vertical overburden pressure at the foundation bearing elevation
equation_formulas.Eq. 5-3: Net bearing pressure approximation when foundation and backfill unit weights equal existing soil unit weight
equation_formulas.Eq. 5-10: Equivalent uniform bearing pressure for eccentrically loaded rectangular foundation using reduced equivalent dimensions B' and L'
equation_formulas.Eq. 5-14: q_all,net ≤ q_ult/F_BC - sigma_zD, subtracting overburden pressure from factored ultimate capacity (Peck et al. 1974)
equation_formulas.Eq. 5-16: qult = c·Nc·Ψc + σzD·Nq·Ψq + 0.5·γ·B·Nγ·Ψγ, using undrained cohesion c, undrained friction angle φ, total unit weight γ, and total vertical stress σzD at bearing elevation
equation_formulas.Eq. 5-18: Ψc = sc · dc · ic · bc · gc
equation_formulas.Eq. 5-19: Ψq = sq · dq · iq · bq · gq
equation_formulas.Eq. 5-20: Ψγ = sγ · dγ · iγ · bγ · gγ
equation_formulas.Eq. 5-21: Ψc,BH,φ=0 = (1 + sc + dc − ic − bc − gc)
equation_formulas.Eq. 5-25: Nc,m,r = Nc,m,c·(B/L) + Nc,m,s·(1 - B/L), interpolating between circular (Nc,m,c) and strip (Nc,m,s) factors by B/L ratio
equation_formulas.Eq. 5-26: H2 = (2B − H1) · (c1 + tan φ1) / (c2 + tan φ2)
equation_formulas.Eq. 5-28: φave = arctan[(H1·tan φ1 + H2·tan φ2) / (H1 + H2)]
equation_formulas.Eq. 6-9: α = 0.28·(su/Pa)^(-0.44), fit to Tomlinson (1994) curve for pile penetration 10b into stiff clay beneath soft clay
equation_formulas.Eq. 6-10: α = 0.3 + 0.17·(Pa/su,ICU) ≤ 1, based on ICU triaxial undrained strength
equation_formulas.Eq. 6-14: α = 0.4·(1 - 0.12·ln(su/Pa)), for soils with clay fraction ≥ 50% and OCR between 3 and 5
equation_formulas.Eq. 6-15: Alpha factor for CFAs in mixed alluvial/loessial deposits (Coleman and Arcement 2002), printed as α = 0.53·(su/Pa) with no exponent (Equation 6-15, PDF p. 457, printed p. 419), valid for su/Pa from 0.24 to 1.42
equation_formulas.Eq. 6-38: Rn,gblock = 2·Z·(B+L)·fs,1 + B·L·su,2·Nc, combining side shaft resistance and base bearing capacity
equation_formulas.Eq. 6-41: Vblock = B·L·Z + (Z²/4)·(B + L) + Z³/12, for uniform soil profile with 4V:1H slope
equation_formulas.Eq. 6-42: We,g = γm·B·L·Z1 + γb·B·L·Z2 + Wcap, accounting for moist and buoyant unit weights
equation_formulas.Eq. 6-43: Rn,block = 2·Z·(B+L)·su,avg + We,g, summing side shear resistance and effective weight of block and cap
equation_formulas.Eq. 6-53: δs = H0 · [Cεr · log(min(σʹz0 + Δσʹz, σʹp)/σʹz0) + Cεc · log(max(σʹz0 + Δσʹz, σʹp)/σʹp)]
equation_formulas.Eq. 6-70: Mmax/Mc ≈ a·(Pt/Pc)^n, using coefficients from Table 6-37
equation_formulas.Eq. 6-71: Mobilized passive resistance of an embedded pile cap as a fraction of fully-mobilized passive resistance, using a hyperbolic load-displacement relationship
equation_formulas.Eq. 7-1: F_X(x_i) = P_X(X ≤ x_i) = Σ (j = 1 to i) P_X(x_i)
equation_formulas.Eq. 7-2: F_X(x_0) = P(X ≤ x_0) = integral from –∞ to x_0 of f_X(x) dx
equation_formulas.Eq. 7-4: P(x_1 ≤ X ≤ x_2) = integral from x_1 to x_2 of f_X(x) dx
equation_formulas.Eq. 7-10: ∆g1 = g(µX1 + σX1, µX2,...,µXn) − g(µX1 − σX1, µX2,...,µXn)
equation_formulas.Eq. 7-14: σ²g(X) ≈ Σ Pi · g(X)²i − (Σ Pi · g(X)i)²
